notes.title: Shores Of Loci Launched the Full Release on Steam!
notes.content:
Shores of Loci launched the full release on Steam on November 3. We added a new World to the game with four challenging puzzles.  We hope you will enjoy this update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846890/Shores_of_Loci/

The Shores of Loci is a single-player narrative puzzle game that can only be experienced in VR. With compelling characters, beautiful cinematic scenes, and surreal worlds, the Shores of Loci will transport you to other dimensions to create visions larger than life.
In this multidimensional story, Giants and Villagers alike need your help to reclaim their lands and rebuild their cities. Complete your journey creating a universe where puzzled pieces are assembled and transformed.

notes.title: Discord Q&A - Friday, June 10th, 5 PM EST
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are so grateful for the reception that we had during the launch. With such results and feedback, we are so excited to get the rest of our plans finished for everyone to experience!

We will be having a Q&A tomorrow on [url=https://discord.gg/KmPkJcqx67]Discord[/url], Friday, June 10th at 5 PM EST. 

So if you have some questions and requests, this will be the best time. Shall we see you tomorrow? Plus some more exciting news for everyone who has purchased while we’re at Early Release!

P.S. Feel free to leave your questions below if you got plans tomorrow.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Fixes the issue where puzzle pieces would be delivered at/below the floor height for some users, based on playspace configuration.

Any existing puzzle pieces trapped below the floor should fly upwards to dislodge themselves.

If you're still experiencing issues, please post on Steam or reach out to us on Discord: https://discord.gg/KmPkJcqx67

notes.title: Shores of Loci OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After months of development, we’re delighted to finally announce that Shores of Loci is coming to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846890/Shores_of_Loci/]SteamVR[/url], [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/6574680562603944/?utm_medium=share&utm_source=oculus]App Lab[/url], and Side Quest is out now!

We cannot wait to hear what you think and to see so many of you walk along our shores. If you like the game, be sure to leave a review on our store page! Reviews are so important to us and help us get seen by more VR users, so every review counts.

Join us and dive into this meditative open-ended puzzle adventure and get lost in wonder.

Here are some breathtaking and calming glimpses, into the many worlds you can explore.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DL3yy64.gif[/img]

Unlock multiple features with different assembly routes each time you play.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uEn2EXWh.gif[/img]

Support giants and villagers alike with reclaiming their lands, and rebuilding their cities. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IejWLrn.gif[/img]

Be on the lookout for giants that are awaiting your arrival, to transport you to their world.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/So6eNqI.gif[/img]

So find yourself washed up along the Shores of Loci.

Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/ShoresofLoci/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/shoresofloci]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/shoresofloci/?hl=en]Instagram[/url] for the latest news and announcements, and join our meditative and welcoming community on [url=https://discord.gg/KmPkJcqx67]Discord[/url] now.
